column2: Table 15: Quantitative Comparison of Improved Proposed Pipeline (Text) and Paper 1 (Setu et al. 2025) on Text Plagiarism Detection

Genuine improved proposed pipeline (Logistic Regression on cheap multi-view lexical/character/structural + TF-IDF features, threshold 0.49) vs Paper 1 (Sentence-BERT all-MiniLM-L6-v2 + TF-IDF hybrid, threshold 0.5000). Identical held-out text test partition (N=3,000 pairs).
Validation-derived dev set for tuning; test partition = 3,000 pairs (random_state=42 sample)
Sentence-BERT all-MiniLM-L6-v2 (384-d embeddings) + sublinear TF-IDF; hybrid score max(TF-IDF, SBERT); threshold 0.5000

Logistic Regression (class_weight=balanced) on cheap multi-view features (word Jaccard, char 3-gram Jaccard, length ratio, TTR similarity, TF-IDF cosine); threshold 0.49. NOTE: SBERT semantic embeddings unavailable in sandbox — lexical-only features cannot capture paraphrase.
Both sides: genuine experimental results from this work. No score manipulation.
